text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Air Messiah! First place goes to Air 
Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With the running style inherited from her 
mother, now—! Air Messiah claims a 
spectacular victory in the Shuka Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Alright. ...Alright!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Magnificent. You pulled it off……!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's some crazy honesty right there, 
seriously...

text_block_list.name: Craft & Messiah
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Messiah-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Today... you were the strongest of all!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Craft-san—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. ...Yes, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Now, at long last... I can hold my head 
high when I return home to report to 
Mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: However... first off, Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to return the very words you gave 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Straightforward and pure. A horse girl 
like the sun... shining down upon all the 
flowers blooming in the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“—It is I who look up to you, Rhein 
Kraft-san.”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Messiah-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she narrowly missed the victory... 
Rhein Kraft returned to the waiting room 
with a bright, beaming smile. And then—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What's our next goal race gonna 
be!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to think properly about what comes 
next. I want to keep running with all my 
heart!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Because everyone gave me their 
heartfelt support.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...It's so shocking, Trainer. Can you 
believe it?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Heart-san, Cesario, and Messiah-san too!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
She told me, "You're the one I look up 
to!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to the senior Tiara Umamusume... 
I still... I still haven't accomplished 
anything at all, but..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even so, everyone told me! All of those 
wonderful people, to me!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I want to run more. I want to 
keep running more and more!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"So that I can become an even more 
dazzling figure to look up to. So I can 
pass it on. So I can leave it behind!"
choice_data_list: I see... Understood. In that case—
I see... Understood. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To Line Craft, so full of positive spirit— 
I will show her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that the Triple Tiara route is behind 
her, what she should show her juniors next 
is herself at her absolute brightest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Rhein Kraft's preferred distance. 
Carving out a new path as the "fastest of 
her generation," true to who she is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Next up is the big race to determine 
the fastest of spring.
choice_data_list:
Let's make the Takamatsunomiya Kinen our 
goal!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "The Takamatsunomiya Kinen"...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In the Senior Year... In that 
race where all the speedsters gather!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I will carve out my own path forward!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Together! Start running alongside me, 
Trainer!
